scripts.build: pnpm --filter frontend build && pnpm --filter site build
scripts.deploy: pnpm --filter frontend build && pnpm --filter site deploy --
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config site/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config site/wrangler.jsonc
